content:
The Awards and Closing Session of the ACA Innovation Challenge, an initiative of the ACA Group, an associate of BUILT CoLAB, took place on April 27, and João Moutinho was a member of the jury.

The aim of this event was to publicize the winning ideas of the challenge and award the winners, but also to debate the associated issues. For this reason, João Moutinho, BUILT CoLAB Director, took part in the round table discussion on innovation in construction.

The event was an excellent opportunity to witness first-hand important steps towards innovation in construction, both from the point of view of digitalization and sustainability. An initiative to be commended and which should serve as an example to others that emerge in the future. The session can be viewed here.
